issues.problem: NVIDIA's fiscal 2024 net income was about $29.76 billion ($29.8B), not $37.2 billion. Net income can't plausibly be higher than the stated operating income of $33.0 billion.

issues.quote: When extracting, record net income as $29.8 billion.
issues.problem: This is an instruction left inside the analysis, not part of the analysis itself, and it contradicts the $37.2B figure stated earlier. It happens to give the correct figure ($29.8B), but the text is internally inconsistent.

data.summary: Most figures match NVIDIA's fiscal 2024 results: revenue of $60.9B, up 125.9% from $27.0B; operating income of about $33.0B; total assets of $65.7B; and cash and cash equivalents of about $7.3B. The net income figure of $37.2B is wrong; the actual figure is about $29.8B. A stray instruction later in the text gives that correct $29.8B figure, so the passage contradicts itself.
